title: Bible Family Feud
tagline: A stage-ready Family Feud for church events.
description: Two teams take turns guessing the most popular answers to Bible questions while a host flips tiles, calls strikes and runs the show from a single screen. Built for the Parent Sunday Variety Service. Nothing to install, no account and no server.
features: 60 original Bible questions, each with eight ranked answers
Automatic strike, steal and pot-banking rules
Private Host Answer View in a second window
Music and sound effects, keyboard shortcuts, works offline
